conventions.walls: S = y0, N = y=D, E = x=W, W = x0 (room-local)
conventions.floor: 32x32, row 0 = N edge (y=D), col 0 = W edge (x=0), index row*32+col
conventions.facade: 4 walls (S,N,E,W) x 16 rows x 32 cols, row 0 = ceiling, S/N col 0 at x=0, E/W col 0 at y=0, 1 = window
conventions.sun_room: unit vector from the sun into the room, room frame (north_angle applied)
conventions.time: TMYx local standard time, mid-hour stamps
